description: spdolan's shared Renovate preset: weekly grouped updates with conventional chore(deps) titles, so they pass the PR-title check and don't cut a release on their own. Use with "extends": ["github>spdolan/project-standards"]. Packages bumped by spdolan/factory's dependency-bump stage go in the repository's own ignoreDeps (for example "@spdolan/plinth").

packageRules.description: Workflows from this repository: callers pin the line tag (@v0.1) on purpose, so don't convert it to a digest; follow new lines in one PR
